_how_to: Promos shown at the top of each venue page (where the WiFi lands). Add, edit or remove entries, then run ./deploy.sh. Fields: kicker (small label), title, text, cta (button text), url (button link), image (file in site/assets/img/), until (optional YYYY-MM-DD: hidden after this date), feature (true = big card).
